posts.text: Far too many Michiganders are being priced out of their American Dream. Right now, a house is too expensive to even think about a picket fence. We must come together to cut red tape and streamline zoning so we can build more housing and help families afford their American Dream.
posts.summary: Calls for zoning reform and reduced red tape to increase housing affordability

I’m glad the legislature extended my executive order to provide Michiganders relief at the gas pump through the end of the summer. 

We’re saving Michigan motorists 10 to 20 cents per gallon while they face increased prices driven by the war in Iran.

posts.text:
Pride is not just a month. Authenticity doesn’t stop on the 30th, visibility doesn’t hide away till next June — supporting the LGBTQ+ community never stops.

As we close out Pride Month, the fight for equality continues. To LGBTQ+ Michiganders, know you are accepted 24/7, 365 🏳️‍🌈
